title: Epidemiology — Basics (sample)
description: 8 sample questions to try the platform. Replace them with your own from PDF.

options: All existing cases at a point in time
New cases occurring during a period in a population at risk
questions.explanation: Incidence counts NEW cases during a specified period among people at risk. Prevalence counts ALL existing cases.

questions.text: Which study design starts with exposure status and follows people forward to see who develops the outcome?
questions.explanation: Cohort studies classify people by exposure first and follow them over time to compare outcome rates.

questions.text: The case-control study design is most suitable for:
questions.explanation: Case-control studies start from people who already have the disease, so they work well for rare diseases. They cannot measure incidence directly.
In a steady state, prevalence ≈ incidence × average duration. Long-lasting diseases build up higher prevalence.
When enough of the population is immune, transmission chains break and susceptible (unvaccinated) people are protected indirectly.

questions.text: Sensitivity of a screening test is the proportion of:
options: Healthy people correctly identified as negative
Diseased people correctly identified as positive
Positive results that are truly diseased
Negative results that are truly healthy
questions.explanation: Sensitivity = true positives / all who have the disease. Specificity = true negatives / all who do not have the disease.

questions.text: Relative risk (RR) is calculated from which type of study?
questions.explanation: RR compares incidence in exposed vs unexposed, which needs incidence data from a cohort study. Case-control studies give the odds ratio.

questions.text: Hepatitis A is mainly transmitted by:
questions.explanation: HAV spreads through contaminated food and water (fecal-oral). Hepatitis B and C spread mainly through blood and body fluids.

questions.text: أي مما يلي يُعد من طرق الوقاية الأولية؟
questions.explanation: الوقاية الأولية تمنع حدوث المرض من الأساس، مثل التطعيم. الكشف المبكر وقاية ثانوية، والتأهيل وقاية ثالثية.

questions.text: معدل وفيات الأطفال الرضع يُحسب لكل:
questions.explanation: معدل وفيات الرضع = عدد وفيات الأطفال أقل من سنة ÷ عدد المواليد الأحياء في نفس السنة × 1000.

questions.text: أهم طريقة للوقاية من الكوليرا هي:
options: توفير مياه شرب نظيفة وصرف صحي آمن
questions.explanation: الكوليرا تنتقل عن طريق المياه والطعام الملوث، لذلك المياه النظيفة والصرف الصحي هما أساس الوقاية.
فترة الحضانة تبدأ من لحظة العدوى (دخول الميكروب) وتنتهي عند ظهور أول الأعراض.
